title: feat(nstrec): nnseed t is not a function of unique L (Euclidean B3)
science: Two-record version of the t-vs-L negative: 61 unique-lock sites, t is not a function of L, and the runner verifies the failure survives dropping BOTH seeds (+e_2 still occurs at ticks 2 and 4; a second non-seed witness is (0,-1,0) t=1 vs (0,-3,0) t=5). States the clean form: formation-tick cannot be recovered from Record content-alone. Together with #7048 this makes the negative seed-independent.
